## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm build` and `pnpm check:links` pass
- [ ] Nothing personal: no personal emails, phone numbers or accounts
- [ ] A change people notice has its line in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] A page that moved leaves a redirect from its old URL
